name: Manali
description: A Himalayan resort town on the Beas River, known for adventure sports and as a gateway to Rohtang Pass.

name: Goa
description: India's smallest state known for golden beaches, Portuguese colonial architecture, and vibrant nightlife.

name: Ladakh
description: The land of high passes. A remote region with dramatic landscapes, Buddhist monasteries, and legendary biking routes.

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City. Capital of Rajasthan known for Hawa Mahal, Amber Fort, and bazaars full of textiles and jewelry.

name: Rishikesh
description: The Yoga Capital of the World, set on the banks of the Ganges. White-water rafting, bungee jumping, and ashram stays.

name: Kerala Backwaters
description: A chain of lagoons and lakes in southern India. Houseboat cruises through palm-fringed waterways and lush countryside.

name: Hampi
description: UNESCO World Heritage Site with ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire scattered among surreal boulder landscapes.

name: Spiti Valley
description: A cold desert mountain valley high in the Himalayas. Ancient monasteries, stark landscapes, and stargazing paradise.

name: Coorg
description: The Scotland of India. Rolling hills, coffee plantations, misty landscapes, and homestays in Karnataka.

name: Varanasi
description: One of the oldest living cities. Sacred ghats on the Ganges, ancient temples, and the evening Ganga Aarti ceremony.

name: Meghalaya
description: The abode of clouds. Living root bridges, Cherrapunji rains, crystal-clear rivers, and deep unexplored caves.

name: Andaman Islands
description: Pristine beaches, coral reefs, and dense tropical forests in the Bay of Bengal. Scuba diving and snorkeling paradise.

name: Darjeeling
description: The Queen of the Hills. Tea gardens, the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, and stunning views of Kangchenjunga.

name: Rann of Kutch
description: A vast white salt desert that transforms under moonlight. The Rann Utsav festival celebrates local culture and handicrafts.

name: Munnar
description: Hill station in Kerala with endless rolling tea plantations, misty mornings, and the rare Neelakurinji flower bloom.
